title: Phylogenetic analyses of Ophiothrix (Echinodermata: Ophiuroidea)
author: Renata Alitto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wimfcc6

steps.title: Align Sequences and Construct Matrix
steps.instruction: Align 16S and COI sequences using the MUSCLE algorithm to create a unified matrix.

substeps.instruction: Add all Ophiothrix angulata (16S) sequences to the matrix.
Add additional Ophiotrichidae (16S, COI) sequences from GenBank for comparison.
Include Amphipholis squamata (Amphiuridae) as the outgroup.

steps.title: Prepare Datasets
steps.instruction: Organize the data into three distinct datasets for analysis.

steps.title: Perform Maximum Parsimony (MP) Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct MP reconstruction using TNT 1.5 program.

substeps.instruction: Obtain most parsimonious trees via heuristic search (best length hit 100 times) using the 'new technology' search option (including sectorial searches, ratchet, tree drifting, and tree fusing).
Treat gaps as a fifth state.
Evaluate nodes using Bootstrap resampling test with 1000 pseudoreplicates via Traditional Search.

steps.title: Perform Bayesian Inference (BI) Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct BI reconstruction using MrBayes, employing the GTR+G model of molecular evolution (selected via AIC and Hierarchical Likelihood Ratio Tests using MR.MODELTEST v.2.3).

substeps.instruction: Run two simultaneous runs using one cold and three incrementally heated Monte Carlo Markov chains (MCMC).
Set temperature parameter value to 0.2 (default) and use a random tree as a starting point.
Run for two million generations, sampling one tree every 100th generation, until the standard deviation of split frequencies between runs is lower than c. 0.005.
Discard the first 25% of total sampled trees as 'burnin'.
Verify convergence and stationary MCMC log-likelihoods using TRACER (ensuring ESS > 200).

steps.title: Perform Maximum Likelihood (ML) Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct ML reconstruction using MEGA v.7.0 program.

substeps.instruction: Obtain statistical support using a bootstrap function with 1000 replicates.

steps.title: Visualize and Edit Trees
steps.instruction: Visualize and edit the resulting phylogenetic trees using FIGTREE v1.4.3.
